'''Quadex''' was a manufacturing company that produced [[Starship/Legends|starship]] components. The company made a name for itself by producing high-output [[Power core/Legends|power cores]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] starships. The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] had a [[Quadex power core/Legends|Quadex energy core]], and the [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighter]] was powered by a Quadex [[Kyromaster ion engine/Legends|Kyromaster]].

{{Company-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Quadex was misspelled "Qualdex" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' and in its strategy guides. This typographical error also appeared in the entry for ''Star Wars Galaxies''{{'s}} Halcyon booster in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.
